name: domeggook-mcp
display_name: Domeggook (B2B wholesale) + Domeggook Open API MCP
description: Domeggook (B2B wholesale) + Domeggook Open API (ecommerce suppliers): me, list_products, get_product

platform_mcp_domeggook_api_key.title: PLATFORM_MCP_DOMEGGOOK_API_KEY
platform_mcp_domeggook_api_key.description: Domeggook Open API key (openapi.domeggook.com > API 키 발급/관리), sent as the `aid` query parameter. The same key serves 도매꾹 and 도매매.

tools.name: me
tools.description: No account endpoint; the probe runs a one-item 도매꾹 (Domeggook) search. An invalid key answers HTTP 200 with {errors{code: 401, dcode: UNAUTHORIZED}}, reported as a tool error.

tools.name: list_products
tools.description: getItemList v4.1 on 도매꾹 (Domeggook) (market=dome): items on sale only. Domeggook requires at least one condition: `query` (kw) or `category` (ca, five two-digit pairs such as 01_11_00_00_00; a top-level-only code is not searchable). Prices are KRW integers; unitQty is the minimum order quantity. Errors arrive as HTTP 200 {errors{code, message, dcode, dmessage}} and are reported as tool errors.

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: getItemView v4.6: basis{no, status, title, dateReg}, price, qty{inventory, domeMoq, domeUnit}, deli (shipping rules), seller info and options in `raw`. price.dome is an integer, or a tier string such as "1+3800|20+3500|50+3300" (quantity+unit price), so it is returned as `dome_price` instead of the numeric `price`.
